content_summary: The visible passages discuss the genus-zero case using sections and a codimension condition, then irreducible divisors and points of codimension 1, discrete valuation rings, normalization, a stabilizer, and its action on a residue field and map to a Galois group. This is a reading summary only, not a proof verification.

OK followed by an opening parenthesis; the q descender, i dot and tall strokes of quitte are visible; localiser ends before the closing parenthesis. No terminal stop visible.

uncertainties: The U subscript is read provisionally as s; e remains possible from its small loop and descending return. No contextual correction is made.
The double-stem E is represented with mathbb solely as a graphic convention.
